# Functions
```{r}
#Function for GSEA with custom gene sets list
autoGSEA <- function(df, TERM2GENE, geneset_name) {
  gsea_results <- list()

  conditions <- df$condition %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  for (condition_i in conditions) {
    
    degs_condition <- df %>%
      filter(condition == condition_i) %>%
      dplyr::select(genes, log2fold_change) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      # mutate(rank = rank(log2fold_change, ties.method = "random")) %>%
      arrange(desc(log2fold_change)) %>% 
      deframe()

    auto_gsea <- tryCatch({
      GSEA(geneList = degs_condition,
           TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
           minGSSize = 1,
           maxGSSize = 1000,
           pvalueCutoff = 1,
           pAdjustMethod = "BH") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        arrange(qvalue) %>%
        mutate(condition = condition_i,
               gsea_enrichment = geneset_name)
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })

    if (!is.null(auto_gsea)) {
      key <- paste(condition_i, geneset_name, sep = "_")
      gsea_results[[key]] <- auto_gsea
    }
  }

  return(list(
    gsea = bind_rows(gsea_results)
  ))
}

#Function for GSEA (Gene Ontology database)
gseGO_all <- function(df, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ontology = "BP") {
  all_conditions <- df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition)
  
  gsea_results <- lapply(all_conditions, function(cond) {
    message("Running for condition: ", cond)
    
    ranked_df <- df %>%
      filter(condition == cond) %>%
      arrange(value)
    
    gene_list <- ranked_df %>%
      arrange(-value) %>%
      pull(value, name = genes)
    
    gsea_result <- tryCatch({
      gseGO(
        geneList = gene_list,
        ont = ontology,
        keyType = keyType,
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        verbose = TRUE,
        OrgDb = OrgDb,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH"
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        arrange(qvalue) %>%
        mutate(
          condition = cond,
          geneset = "Gene ontology, BP"
        ) %>%
        clean_names()
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Error in GSEA for condition: ", cond)
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    return(gsea_result)
  })
  
  bind_rows(gsea_results)
}


#Function for ORA/ENRICHER custom
enricher_condition <- function(df, term2gene_df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition) %>%
    set_names() %>%
    map_dfr(function(cond) {
      genes <- df %>%
        filter(condition == cond) %>%
        pull(genes)

      result <- tryCatch({
        enricher(
          gene = genes,
          pvalueCutoff = 0.50,
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          TERM2GENE = term2gene_df
        ) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          mutate(condition = cond)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Failed on condition: ", cond)
        return(NULL)
      })

      return(result)
    })
}

# Function for ORA Gene Ontology
oraGO_condition <- function(df, orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db) {
  df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition) %>%
    set_names() %>%
    map_dfr(function(cond) {
      genes <- df %>%
        filter(condition == cond) %>%
        pull(genes)

      result <- tryCatch({
        enrichGO(
          gene = genes,
          OrgDb = orgdb,
          keyType = 'SYMBOL',
          readable = T,
          ont = "BP",
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          qvalueCutoff = 1) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          mutate(condition = cond)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Failed on condition: ", cond)
        return(NULL)
      })

      return(result)
    })
}
```

## Gene sets construction


### Blood transcription modules <https://www.nature.com/articles/ni.2789>

```{r}
#Converter ítens de "Module member genes" em linhas em uma tabela longa
btm_annotation_table_long_immune <- BTM_modules %>%
  separate_rows(`Module member genes`, sep = ",") %>% 
  filter(`Module category` == "immune")

#Salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_table_long_immune, file = "btm_annotation_table_long_immune.csv")

#Display
head(btm_annotation_table_long_immune)

#Calculate Set size
btm_annotation_nested <- btm_annotation_table_long_immune %>%
  group_by(`Module title`) %>% #Somar e agrupar
  mutate(SetSize = n())

#Convert gene symbol column to aggregated rows
btm_annotation_nested <- btm_annotation_nested %>%
  group_by(`Module title`) %>%
  summarize(Genes = paste(`Module member genes`, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(btm_annotation_nested, by = "Module title") %>% 
  filter(Genes != "NA") %>% 
  relocate(Genes, .after="SetSize")

#Salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_nested, file = "btm_annotation_genes.csv")

#Convert to unique values table
btm_annotation_unique = btm_annotation_nested %>% 
  dplyr::select(-`Module member genes`)

btm_annotation_unique = btm_annotation_unique %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  relocate(Genes, .after="SetSize") %>% 
  filter(Genes != "NA")

#salvar
write.csv(btm_annotation_unique, file = "btm_annotation_unique.csv")

#Display
head(btm_annotation_unique)

btm_annotation_table_long_immune
```

### CellMarker

Download database from
"<http://117.50.127.228/CellMarker/CellMarker_download_files/file/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx>"

```{r}
##################### Baixar tabela de marcadores celulares

url <- "http://117.50.127.228/CellMarker/CellMarker_download_files/file/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx" 
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
download.file(url, f)
cell_marker_data <- readxl::read_excel(f, 1)

##################### Sub-agrupar células por sistema imunológico

#Filtrar marcadores e células por tecido (Blood)
cells <- cell_marker_data %>%
    filter(tissue_class == "Blood") %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_name, marker)

##################### Filtrar células
# Acessar todos os tipos de células no dataset de Blood
cellmarker_celltypes <- unique(cells$cell_name)

# Filtrar apenas os tipos que contêm "B cell" e plasmacell
Bcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("B cell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #44 outputs
Plasmacells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("plasma", cellmarker_celltypes)] #5 outputs

# Filtrar apenas os tipos que contêm "T cell" e seus subtipos "CD4" e "CD8"
Tcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("T cell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #93 outputs
TCD4_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("CD4", cellmarker_celltypes)] #35 outputs
TCD8_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("CD8", cellmarker_celltypes)] #34 outputs
Treg_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("Treg", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
Thelper_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("helper", cellmarker_celltypes)] #17 outputs

# Filtrar outros tipos celulares da resposta imune
Neutrophils_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("neutrophil", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
Monocyte_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("monocyte", cellmarker_celltypes)] #14 outputs
DCells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("dendritic", cellmarker_celltypes)] #25 outputs
Macrophages_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("macrophage", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs
NKcells_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("killer", cellmarker_celltypes)] # 11 outputs
Neutrophils_no = cellmarker_celltypes[grep("mastcell", cellmarker_celltypes)] #7 outputs

# Criar variáveis para cada célula para enriquecimento

# Filtrar apenas as células da resposta imune adaptativa
Bcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("B cell|plasma cell|plasmablast", ignore_case = TRUE)))
TCD4 <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("CD4", ignore_case = TRUE)))
TCD8 <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("CD8", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Treg <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Treg", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Thelper <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("helper", ignore_case = TRUE)))


# Filtrar células da resposta imune inata
Neutrophils <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("neutrophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Monocyte <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("monocyte", ignore_case = TRUE)))
DCells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("dendritic", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Macrophages <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("macrophage", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Mastcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("mast cell", ignore_case = TRUE)))
NKcells <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("killer", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Platelets <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Platelet", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Eosinophil <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Eosinophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Basophil <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Basophil", ignore_case = TRUE)))
Granulocyte <- filter(cells, str_detect(cell_name, regex("Granulocyte", ignore_case = TRUE)))

#Agrupar todos os resultados em Immune cells
Immune_adap = rbind(Bcells, TCD4, TCD8, Treg, Thelper)
Immune_adap$Type = "Adaptive"

Immune_innate = rbind(Neutrophils, Monocyte, DCells, Macrophages, Mastcells, NKcells, Platelets, Eosinophil, Basophil, Granulocyte)
Immune_innate$Type = "Innate"

#Unir tabelas
Immune_cells = rbind(Immune_adap, Immune_innate) 

#Salvar
write.csv(Immune_cells, file = "CellMarker_ImmuneCells.csv")

esquisser(Immune_cells_markersbycells)
```

### ImmuneGO

```{r}
organism = "org.Mm.eg.db"
# install.packages("GO.db")
BiocManager::install(organism, character.only = TRUE)
library(organism, character.only = TRUE)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(GO.db)

#HGNC symbol to Entrez
x <- org.Mm.egSYMBOL
mapped_genes <- mappedkeys(x)
symbols_entrez <- as.data.frame(x[mapped_genes])

## Entrez to GO
x <- org.Mm.egGO
mapped_genes <- mappedkeys(x)
entrez_geneontology <- as.data.frame(x[mapped_genes])

## GO BP ancestors
go_bp_ancestor = GOBPANCESTOR %>% 
  as.data.frame()
colnames(go_bp_ancestor)[1] <- "go_id"
colnames(go_bp_ancestor)[2] <- "go_ancestor"

## GO ID to terms
go_bp = AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, columns=c("GOID","TERM"), keys= "BP", keytype= "ONTOLOGY") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::select(go_id = goid, term)

## GO child and ancestor
go_bp_ancestor = go_bp_ancestor %>% 
  inner_join(go_bp %>% rename(go_ancestor = go_id), by = "go_ancestor") %>% 
  rename(term_ancestor = term)

#GO ids to terms
go_bp = AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, columns=c("GOID","TERM"), keys="BP", keytype="ONTOLOGY") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(go_id = goid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ontology) %>% 
  right_join(entrez_geneontology, by = "go_id") %>% 
  right_join(symbols_entrez, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  left_join(go_bp_ancestor, by = "go_id") %>% 
  distinct()

#GO immune process

mm_immunego_go.bp = go_bp %>% 
  filter(term_ancestor == "immune system process") %>% 
  rename(go_dataset = term_ancestor,
         process = term,
         genes = symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = toupper(process),
         immune_set = "Mouse_ImmuneGO")


```

Annotation

There are 943 processes retrieved, but only 18 are directly annotated using Human ImmuneGO. Most general immunological processes are in, like innate immune response,immune response, adaptive immune response, and others.
```{r}
#Merge annotations with Human ImmuneGO

ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific = read_csv(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific.csv"))

ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_original <- read_csv(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_originalGOs.csv"))

## There are 943 processes
mm_immunego_annotation = mm_immunego_go.bp %>% 
  select(process, genes, immune_set) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarize(set_size = n(),
            genes,
            immune_set) %>% 
  summarize(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            set_size,
            genes,
            immune_set) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()  %>% 
  left_join(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_original %>% 
              mutate(process_human = str_to_upper(process)) %>% 
              select(process_go_human = process_go, process_human = process, go_term_human = go_term, immune_system:cells),
                by = join_by("process" == "process_go_human"))
#Save
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  saveRDS(here("VaxGO", "mm_immunego_annotation.rds"))
mm_immunego_annotation %>% 
  write_excel_csv(here("VaxGO", "mm_immunego_annotation.csv"))
```

#### Approach 1

```{r}
library(readxl)
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx"))
```

#### Approach 2
By percentage: The gene sets were merged exclusively by genes that were in both gene sets. The percentage was calculated by the frequency of each process in human ImmuneGO divided by the mouse set_size.
```{r}
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_match = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process_mice = process, genes_mice = genes_upper, set_size) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets %>%
            filter(immune_set %in% c("ImmuneGO", "ImmuneGO by Modules")) %>% 
              separate_rows(genes) %>% 
              select(process, genes, immune_system:cells,
                     immune_set,
                     set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
              rename(process_human = process, 
                     genes_human = genes) %>% 
              mutate(immune_system = if_else(is.na(immune_system), "Manual annotation", immune_system),
                     immune_subsystem = if_else(is.na(immune_subsystem), "Manual annotation", immune_subsystem),
                     cells = if_else(is.na(cells), "Manual annotation", cells)),
            by = join_by("genes_mice" == "genes_human")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(process_mice, process_human) %>% 
  arrange(process_mice, process_human) %>% 
  summarize(set_size_mice = set_size,
            set_size_human, 
            match_human = n(),
            match_perc = match_human/set_size*100,
            immune_system,
            immune_subsystem,
            cells,
            immune_set) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(process_mice) %>% 
  arrange(-match_human, -match_perc) %>% 
  ungroup()
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_match
```


Specific processes
```{r}
mm_immunego_annotation_genes_match = mm_immunego_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process_mice = process, set_size) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_specific_original %>%
              select(process, process_go_human = process_go, genes, immune_system:cells,
                     immune_set,
                     set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
              rename(process_human = process, 
                     genes_human = genes),
            by = join_by("process_mice" == "process_go_human"))
```

```{r}
  mutate(process = "IMMUNOGLOBULIN MEDIATED RESPONSE",
  `Gene set, short` = "Ig-mediated response",
  `Immune system` = "Adaptive",
  `Immune sub-system` = "Humoral",
  `Immune tissue` = "B cell",
  `GO.TERM` = "Manual") %>% 
  clean_names()

ImmuneGO_other <- ImmuneGO_Annotated_unique %>%
  filter(immune_system == "General" |
         immune_tissue == "Leukocyte") %>% 
  summarize(set_size = n(), 
            genes = paste(genes, collapse = ",")) %>% 
  mutate(process = "GENERAL",
  `Gene set, short` = "General",
  `Immune system` = "General",
  `Immune sub-system` = "General",
  `Immune tissue` = "General",
  `GO.TERM` = "Manual") %>% 
  clean_names()


ImmuneGO_antimicrobial <- ImmuneGO_Annotated_unique %>%
  filter(immune_tissue == "Antimicrobial") %>% 
  summarize(set_size = n(), 
            genes = paste(genes, collapse = ",")) %>% 
  mutate(process = "ANTIMICROBIAL",
  `Gene set, short` = "Antimicrobial immune response",
  `Immune system` = "General",
  `Immune sub-system` = "General",
  `Immune tissue` = "General",
  `GO.TERM` = "Manual") %>% 
  clean_names()


# Unite sets -----

ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO = bind_rows(ImmuneGO_Adaptive, 
                            ImmuneGO_Innate, 
                            ImmuneGO_Complement, 
                            ImmuneGO_Inflammation,
                            ImmuneGO_Interferon,
                            ImmuneGO_ARPP,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_Macrophage,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_Mastcell,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_Neutrophil,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_Eosinophil,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_NK,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_Monocyte,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Cellular,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Tcell,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Thelper,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Humoral,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Bcell,
                            ImmuneGO_Adap_Ig,
                            ImmuneGO_other,
                            ImmuneGO_antimicrobial,
                            ImmuneGO_Innate_DC,
                            ImmuneGO_Annotated_unique) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process:go_term, set_size:genes) %>% 
  distinct()

ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes = ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO %>% 
   separate_rows(genes, sep = ",")

# Separate TCR and BCR repertoire genes
TCR_BCR_repertoire = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% 
  filter(grepl("^TR", genes) & process == "ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
           grepl("^IG", genes) & process == "ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
           grepl("^TR", genes) & process == "CELLULAR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM" |
         grepl("^IG", genes) & process == "HUMORAL ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM") %>% 
  mutate(process = if_else(process == "CELLULAR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM", "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                           "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         gene_set_short = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                                  "TCR REPERTOIRE", 
                           "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         process = if_else(grepl("^TR", genes), "TCR REPERTOIRE", "BCR REPERTOIRE"),
         immune_sub_system = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", "Cellular", "Humoral"),
         immune_tissue = if_else(process == "TCR REPERTOIRE", "Cellular", "Humoral"))

immunego_manual = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>%
  filter(go_term == "Manual") %>% 
  anti_join(TCR_BCR_repertoire %>% dplyr::select(genes) %>% distinct(), by = "genes") %>% 
  bind_rows()

#Verify if all genes are annotated. If there are no left genes, you are good to go
a = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% filter(go_term == "Manual") %>% dplyr::select(genes) %>% distinct()
ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% dplyr::select(process, genes, immune_system) %>% anti_join(a, by = "genes")


#Salvar
write.csv(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_", today(), ".csv"), row.names = F)
saveRDS(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_", today(), ".rds"))
saveRDS(ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes, file = paste0("ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes_", today(), ".rds"))

#Display
view(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO)
view(ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes)
```

### ImmuneGO + BTM

```{r}
btm_annotation_genes = readRDS(here("VaxGO gene sets", "btm_annotation_genes.rds"))
ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes = readRDS(here("VaxGO gene sets", "ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes_2024-03-26.rds"))
ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO = read_csv(here("VaxGO gene sets", "ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO_2024_03_26.csv"))

#Unite genes
immunego_btm_genes = ImmuneGO_Annotated_Genes %>% 
              dplyr::select(genes) %>% 
              distinct() %>% 
              mutate(set = "ImmuneGO") %>% 
  bind_rows(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
              dplyr::select(genes) %>% 
              distinct() %>% 
              mutate(set = "BTM")) %>% 
  arrange(genes)

immunego_btm_genes_joined = immunego_btm_genes %>% 
  bind_rows(immunego_btm_genes %>% mutate(set = "BTM and ImmuneGO")) %>% 
  distinct()


#Unite subsets
btm_annotation_grouped = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  group_by(complete_name) %>% 
  rename(process = complete_name) %>% 
  mutate(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ",")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            immune_set = "BTM by Modules") %>% 
    dplyr::select(process,
           immune_system:cells,
           set_size = module_size,
           genes,
           immune_set)

ImmuneGO_annotation_modules = ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO %>% 
  filter(go_term != "Manual") %>% 
    dplyr::select(process = gene_set_short, 
           immune_system:immune_tissue,
           set_size, genes) %>% 
    rename(cells = immune_tissue,
           immune_subsystem = immune_sub_system) %>% 
    mutate(immune_set = "ImmuneGO by Modules")

immunego_btm_specific_grouped = btm_annotation_grouped %>% 
  bind_rows(ImmuneGO_annotation_modules)
  
immunego_btm_specific_grouped %>% 
  write_csv(file = here("VaxGO gene sets", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets_specific.csv"))

  
#By immune system
btm_immunesystem = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  dplyr::select(immune_system, genes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(process = immune_system) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarize(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            set_size = n(),
            process = str_to_upper(process),
            # id = process,
            immune_system = process,
            immune_subsystem = process,
            cells = process,
            complete_name = process,
            annotation_level = "Manual",
            immune_set = "BTM by Immune System") %>% 
  distinct()

#By immune subsystem
btm_immunesubsystem = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  dplyr::select(immune_subsystem, genes) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(process = immune_subsystem) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarize(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            process = str_to_upper(process),
            set_size = n(),
            # id = process,
            immune_system = process,
            immune_subsystem = process,
            cells = process,
            complete_name = process,
            annotation_level = "Manual",
            immune_set = "BTM by Immune Sub-System") %>% 
  distinct() 
#By cell
btm_cells = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  dplyr::select(cells, genes) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(process = cells) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>% 
  summarize(genes = paste0(genes, collapse = ","),
            set_size = n(),
            process = str_to_upper(process),
            # id = process,
            immune_system = process,
            immune_subsystem = process,
            cells = process,
            annotation_level = "Manual",
            complete_name = process,
            immune_set = "BTM by Immune Cell") %>% 
  distinct() 
#Merge
btm_manual = bind_rows(btm_immunesystem,
          btm_immunesubsystem,
          btm_cells) %>% 
  arrange(complete_name) %>% 
  dplyr::select(complete_name, everything()) %>% 
  distinct()

btm_manual_grouped = bind_rows(btm_manual,
                               btm_annotation_grouped) %>% 
  distinct()


#Merge ImmuneGO and BTM main processes
immunego_btm_manual_grouped = btm_manual %>% 
  dplyr::select(process, genes, immune_set, set_size) %>% 
  mutate(immune_set = "BTM") %>% 
  bind_rows(ImmuneGO_Annotated_GO %>% 
              filter(go_term == "Manual") %>% 
              dplyr::select(process, genes, set_size) %>% 
              mutate(immune_set = "ImmuneGO")) %>% 
  arrange(process) %>% 
  mutate(process = case_when(process == "ADAPTIVE" ~ "ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "ALL" ~ "IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "GENERAL" ~ "LEUKOCYTES",
                              process == "CELLS" ~ "LEUKOCYTES",
                              process == "DCS" ~ "DENDRITIC CELL",
                              process == "APP" ~ "ARPP",
                              process == "CELLULAR" ~ "CELLULAR ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "DCS, MYELOID" ~ "DENDRITIC CELL",
                              process == "GENERIC" ~ "LEUKOCYTES",
                              process == "HUMORAL" ~ "HUMORAL ADAPTIVE IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "INNATE" ~ "INNATE IMMUNE SYSTEM",
                              process == "INTERFERON" ~ "ANTIVIRAL & IFN",
                              process == "NK" ~ "NK CELL",
                              process == "B CELL, PLASMA CELL" ~ "B CELL",
                              process == "PLASMA CELL" ~ "B CELL",
                              process == "PRR" ~ "ARPP",
                              process == "SIGNALING" ~ "SIGNALING",
                              process == "TH2" ~ "T CELL",
                              process == "TH1" ~ "T CELL",
                              process == "T HELPER CELLS" ~ "T CELL",
                              TRUE ~ process
                              )) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  bind_rows(
    immunego_btm_specific_grouped)

immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes = immunego_btm_manual_grouped %>%
  separate_rows(genes, sep = ",") %>% 
  distinct()

immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes = immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes %>% 
  bind_rows(
    immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes %>% 
      mutate(immune_set = "BTM and ImmuneGO") %>% 
      distinct()
  )
  
  
immunego_btm_manual_grouped %>% 
  write_csv(file = here("VaxGO gene sets", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets.csv"))

immunego_btm_manual_grouped_genes %>% 
  write_csv(file = here("VaxGO gene sets", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
```

## Download datasets

Download general data (counts data and metadata). GEO supplementary
files have the counts matrices. Download studies individually. I
recommend downloading large files from the GEO website.

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
filename = "GSE120661"
```

## Annotate genes

```{r}
library(biomaRt)

listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,  # <- Replace with your vector of probe IDs
  mart = ensembl_mart
)
```

## Filter genes with highest median expression

- 39,430 probes in the microarray,
- 39,392 that were annotated in BiomaRt (~99.90%)
- 37,983 probes had a correspondent mgi symbol (96.33% of probes in microarray)
- 31,140 probes had a correspondent entrez id (78.97% of probes in microarray)
- 30,787 probes with entrez id also had a correspondent mgi_symbol (78.08% of probes in microarray)
- 22,435 probes have an entrez gene id. As this is the input in FIT, we used this to filter, not mgi_symbol (56.89% of probes in microarray)
- 21,744 genes were filtered by the highest median (55.14% were kept from the microarray)
- 86 Dupes. The duplication is due to different mgi_symbols. Same Entrez IDs can correspond to different mgi_symbol
- 20849 probes were used (52.87%)

```{r}

#Get annotations for each probe 

GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") 

# Stats
## 39430 probes in the microarray
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% dim()
## 37,983 probes with mgi_symbol
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(mgi_symbol) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "")
## 31,140 probes with Entrez gene id
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id)
## 30,787 of these probes with mgi_symbol also had a correspondent entrez gene id
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(mgi_symbol) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id)
## 30,787 probes with entrez id also had a correspondent mgi_symbol
GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  filter(mgi_symbol != "") 

#Get the probes with the highest median across samples for each entrez_id
GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes = GSE120661_counts_normalized_summary %>% 
  drop_na(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(entrezgene_id, probe)  %>% 
  select(probe, entrezgene_id, mgi_symbol, median) %>% 
  distinct()

#86 Dupes. The duplication is due to different mgi_symbols. Same Entrez IDs can correspond to different mgi_symbol
GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes %>% 
  get_dupes(entrezgene_id)

#Modify expression matrix
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  filter(probe %in% c(GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes$probe)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("probe") %>% 
  as.matrix()

GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% dim()


GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix.rds"))


GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = subject_id,
         subject_id = str_remove(subject_id, "_\\d+h")) %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))

```



##Differential gene expression
```{r}

#Import
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix = 
  read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix.rds"))
GSE120661_samples_pbmc = 
  read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))


GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad = GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad")

GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad$geo_sample)) %>% 
  as.matrix()

dim(GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad) #20845   35

dim(AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))) #35
    
eset_filtered <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))
)

design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, eset_filtered) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Then we estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject:
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$subject_id)
corfit$consensus
# Then this inter-subject correlation is input into the linear model fit:
#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, design, 
             block = eset_filtered$subject_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)
```

```{r}
#Test for Fluad
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFluad_4_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_8_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_24_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_48_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_72_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_168_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- treat(fit2, lfc = 0.0)




#Get DEGs
## For one contrast (example)
# all_degs = topTreat(fit2, coef = 1, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("probe")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionFluad_4_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_4_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_8_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_8_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_24_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_48_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_48_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_72_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_168_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())
	
all_degs
```

### Gene annotation
- 27,317 genes in the input matrix
- 25,035 probes from DGE analysis (no lfc threshold)

About FIT genes:
- 16,425 genes in FIT analysis (including human and mouse genes)
- 16,417 unique mouse to human genes (are duplicated)
- 34 genes have either different hgnc symbol to mgi symbol, or the other way.
- 16 human genes are repeated because of different Entrez IDs
- 14,357 mouse genes in FIT are in the limma output. 
- 14,448 unique human genes 
- 223 mouse symbols correspond to the same or another human symbol

### Loop for every time point
```{r}

all_degs_fit2 = read_csv(here("tables", "Fluad_PBMC_FIT_mouse_allTimePoints.csv"))

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row")
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

```
## Loop FIT for every timepoint
Obs: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved

Initial number of genes: 15503
Number of genes for which FIT predictions will be calculated: 14401

```{r}
#Import files
pca_rotations = FIT.mouse2man::pca_rotations
best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez
MM_Entrez_symbol_desc = FIT.mouse2man::MM_Entrez_symbol_desc
Psoriasis_classifier_neg = FIT.mouse2man::Psoriasis_classifier_neg
slopes_per_gene_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::slopes_per_gene_V2.0
StaphInfection_classifier_pos = FIT.mouse2man::StaphInfection_classifier_pos
AllData_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::AllData_V2.0 #Training data


# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  # 1. Monta o caminho do CSV
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  # 2. Roda o FIT
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")
  
  # 3. Converte para tibble e adiciona a coluna da condição
  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})

fit_results_combined

fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "FIT_FLUAD_alltimes.csv"))
```

```{r}
  mutate(l2fc = sign(fold_change) * log2(abs(fold_change))) %>% 
  group_by(genes, exposure_material_reported, adjuvant, study_time_collected) %>% 
    summarize(mean = mean(l2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(l2fc, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
    study_time_collected,
    vaccine_type,
    adjuvant) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
pairwise_human_fit_measures = meta_human %>% 
  inner_join(meta_fit, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(meta_mouse, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit, by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(ci_width_mouse = ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse,
          ci_width_fit = ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit,
          ci_width_human = ci_high_human - ci_low_human) %>% 
  mutate(
        # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    z_human = mean_human / se_human,
    z_fit = mean_fit / se_fit,
    z_mouse = mean_mouse / se_mouse,
    pval_human  = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_human)),
    pval_fit = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_fit)),
    pval_mouse = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_mouse)),
    pval_human_adj = p.adjust(pval_human, method = "BH"),
    pval_fit_adj = p.adjust(pval_fit, method = "BH"),
    pval_mouse_adj = p.adjust(pval_mouse, method = "BH"),)
```

#### Heatmap (Mouse immune processes)

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20}
# Function for clustering by day
cluster_by_day <- function(df, day_column = "day", condition_column = "condition") {
  
  # Obter os níveis do fator da coluna de dias
  days <- levels(df[[day_column]])
  
  # Inicializar uma lista para armazenar as ordens
  orders <- list()
  
  # Loop por cada nível (dia) da coluna fator day
  for (day_value in days) {
    # Filtrar os dados para o dia atual
    day_data <- df %>%
      filter(!!sym(day_column) == day_value) %>%
      dplyr::select(!!sym(condition_column)) %>%
      distinct()
    
    # Criar uma matriz binária onde 1 representa a presença da condição
    if (nrow(day_data) > 1) {
      # Matriz com condições como rótulos e 1 para presença
      presence_matrix <- table(day_data[[condition_column]]) > 0
      dist_matrix <- as.matrix(presence_matrix)
      
      # Aplicar o clustering
      col_clustered <- dist(dist_matrix) %>% hclust()
      
      # Armazenar a ordem dos clusters
      orders[[day_value]] <- col_clustered$labels[col_clustered$order]
    } else {
      # Se houver apenas uma condição, armazenar o rótulo
      orders[[day_value]] <- as.character(day_data[[condition_column]])
    }
  }
  
  # Converter a lista de ordens para um data frame
  order_df <- data.frame(
    day = rep(names(orders), sapply(orders, length)),
    condition = unlist(orders)
  )
  
  return(order_df)
}

```

```{r fig.height=15, fig.width=8}
                  id = fct_relevel(id, c(row_clustered$labels)),
         id = fct_rev(id)) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ "")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = id, fill = nes, size = logq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white",
            size = 0,
            na.rm = F) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          axis.line.x  = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          # panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#4DBBD5FF",      # azul para -1
  mid = "white",          # branco para 0
  high = "#DC0000FF",     # vermelho para +1
  midpoint = 0,
  oob = scales::squish,
  limits = c(-1, 2),      # fixa o intervalo
  name = "NES", ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6))
```

# Get best and worst predicted genes
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))

pairwise_human_fit_test = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
  mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    
    # Combine SE
    se_diff_human_fit = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_fit^2),
    se_diff_human_mouse = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_mouse^2),
    
    # Z score
    z_score_human_fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_human_fit,
    z_score_human_mouse = human_2_mouse / se_diff_human_mouse,
    
    # p-value
    p_value_fit = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_human_fit))),
    p_value_mouse = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_human_mouse))),
    
    # FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    p_value_fit_adj = p.adjust(p_value_fit, method = "BH"),
    p_value_mouse_adj = p.adjust(p_value_mouse, method = "BH"),
    
    # Cohen's d
    effect_size_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_human_fit,
    effect_size_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_human_mouse
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value_fit)

pairwise_human_fit_test 

pairwise_human_fit_test %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_test.rds"))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
  summarize(n_genes = n(),
            condition = "Mouse") %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_human %>%
              group_by(timepoint) %>%
              summarize(n_genes = n(),
                        condition = "Human"))
degs_mouse_summarize

#Overlap
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse and Human")
#Anti join, Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse")
#Anti join, Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human")
  

#Merge data
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human All DEGs") %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_mouse_genes %>% 
              mutate(condition = "Mouse All DEGs")) %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes)

degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(condition, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(n = n())
```

### Get overlap

```{r}
degs_human_mouse_overlap_common = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("Mouse and Human", 
                          "Human All DEGs",
                          "Mouse All DEGs")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,
              values_from = "n") %>% 
  mutate(pct_in_human = (`Mouse and Human`/`Human All DEGs`)*100,
         pct_in_mouse = (`Mouse and Human`/`Mouse All DEGs`)*100,
         human_common = `Mouse and Human`,
         mouse_common = `Mouse and Human`,
         human_out = (`Human All DEGs` - `Mouse and Human`),
         mouse_out = (`Mouse All DEGs` - `Mouse and Human`),
         )  %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(timepoint, "pct_in_human",
                          "pct_in_mouse"), 
               names_to = "condition", 
               values_to = "value")  %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("pct_in_human",
                          "pct_in_mouse"), names_to = "pct", values_to = "pct_value") %>% 
  filter((str_detect(condition, "human") & str_detect(pct, "human")) |
    (str_detect(condition, "mouse") & str_detect(pct, "mouse"))) %>% 

  filter(!condition %in% c("Human All DEGs", 
                         "Mouse All DEGs",
                         "Mouse and Human")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(str_detect(condition, "human"), "Human", "Mouse"),
         condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "_common"), "Common", organism),
         condition = fct_rev(condition))


#Plot

degs_human_mouse_overlap_common_plot = degs_human_mouse_overlap_common %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = organism,
      y = value,
      fill = interact(condition, organism)) + 
  geom_col(alpha = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint)) +
  geom_text(aes(y = value,
                label = if_else(condition == "Common",paste0(round(pct_value, 1), "%"), "")),
            size = 2.5, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5, angle = 0, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10, 
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01),
                     limits = c(0, 1600)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Common" = "black"))   +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Common" = "black")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    # strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "NA", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"), 
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.5, 0.95),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Total",
    color = "",
    fill = "",
    title = "Total DEGs",
       subtitle = "Cutoffs: p_adjust < 0.05.")
```

### By correlation of z score
Get positively and negatively correlated genes and discretize by quantile
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Positively correlated 
positive_correlated = zscore_genes %>%
                    group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_human_mouse)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3))

positive_correlated %>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_mouse$human_symbol),
         human_symbol %in% c(degs_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  filter(abs(diff) < 0.02)
```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Negatively correlated
a_neg = zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_mouse < 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse)

b_pos = zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_human > 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human)

c_down = a_neg %>% 
  inner_join(b_pos, by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - abs(mean_mouse),
         diff = round(diff, 3)) %>% 
  arrange(abs(diff))

a_pos = zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_mouse > 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse, z_score_human_mouse)

b_neg = zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_human < 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human)

c_up = a_pos %>% 
  inner_join(b_neg, by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(diff = abs(mean_human) - abs(mean_mouse),
         diff = round(diff, 3)) %>% 
  arrange(abs(diff))

neg_correlated = bind_rows(c_down, c_up) %>% 
  mutate(mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3))


pos_neg_correlated = neg_correlated %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Negatively correlated") %>% 
  bind_rows(positive_correlated %>% 
              mutate(condition = "Positively correlated"))


quantiles <- quantile(abs(degs_pos_neg_all$diff), 
                    probs = c(0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), 
                    na.rm = TRUE)
degs_pos_neg_mouse = pos_neg_correlated%>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_mouse$human_symbol),
         human_symbol %in% c(degs_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  #Split by quantile
    mutate(
    Q10 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[1],
    Q25 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[2],
    Q50 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[3],
    Q75 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[4],
    Q100 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[5]
  ) %>%
  #Cumulative
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Q"),
               names_to = "quantile_label",
               values_to = "in_quantile") %>%
  mutate(quantile_label = fct_relevel(quantile_label, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)


degs_pos_neg_mouse_split = pos_neg_correlated%>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_mouse$human_symbol),
         human_symbol %in% c(degs_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_diff = cut(abs(diff),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(diff),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")))


degs_pos_neg_mouse_all_positive = pos_neg_correlated %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(condition == "Positively correlated") %>% 
  anti_join(pos_neg_correlated %>% 
              filter(condition == "Negatively correlated"),
            by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint"))


degs_pos_neg_mouse_all = degs_pos_neg_mouse_all_positive %>% 
  bind_rows(pos_neg_correlated %>% 
              filter(condition == "Negatively correlated"))

```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
genes_vary_human_all_diff = degs_pos_neg_mouse_split %>% 
  filter(quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = if_else(condition == "Positively correlated", "Positive", "Negative"),
    condition_quantile = paste0(condition, " (D", timepoint, ") ", quartiles_grouped)) %>%
  select(-condition) %>% 
  rename(value = diff,
         genes = human_symbol,
         condition = condition_quantile) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)"),
         timepoint = str_extract(timepoint, "\\d+"),
         timepoint = paste("Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Negative"), "Negative", "Positive"))
```

```{r}

degs_segments <- degs_pos_neg_mouse %>%
  filter(quantile_label %in% c("Q25")) %>%
  mutate(quantile_label = if_else(quantile_label == "Q25", "<Q25", quantile_label)) %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_pos_neg_mouse_split %>% 
    mutate(quantile_label = if_else(quartiles_diff == "Q100" | 
                                      quartiles_diff == "Q75", "Q75>", 
                                    quartiles_diff)) %>% 
      filter(quantile_label == "Q75>")) %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, quantile_label) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_human_next = lead(mean_human),
    mean_mouse_next = lead(mean_mouse),
    timepoint_next = lead(timepoint),
    direction = paste0("D", timepoint, "→D", timepoint_next)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_human_next), !is.na(mean_mouse_next)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!(mean_human == mean_human_next & mean_mouse == mean_mouse_next))
  
  

degs_segments
```

### Enrichment analysis

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"

library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)

#Scatter plot extracted DEGs
genes_vary_human_all_diff = degs_pos_neg_mouse_split %>% 
  filter(quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = if_else(condition == "Positively correlated", "Positive", "Negative"),
    condition_quantile = paste0(condition, " (D", timepoint, ") ", quartiles_grouped)) %>%
  select(-condition) %>% 
  rename(value = diff,
         genes = human_symbol,
         condition = condition_quantile)

# #GSEA for GOs
# gseGO_all_diff = gseGO_all(genes_vary_human_all_diff)

#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_df <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = human_gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

# gsea_hallmarks_all_diff= autoGSEA(df = genes_vary_human_all_diff %>% 
#                                     rename(log2fold_change = value),
#          TERM2GENE = msigdbr_df,
#          geneset_name = "Hallmarks MSigDB") %>% 
#   clean_names()

#ORA DIFF
oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions <- oraGO_condition(genes_vary_human_all_diff,
                                                     orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db) %>%
  mutate(log_q = -log10(qvalue)) %>%
  arrange(-log_q)

oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_clean = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions %>%
  mutate(description = str_replace(description, "regulation", "Reg."),
         description = str_replace(description, "positive", "(+)"),
         description = str_replace(description, "negative", "(-)")) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(timepoint, "\\d+"))

#ORA Hallmarks DIFF
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = genes_vary_human_all_diff,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(timepoint, "\\d+"))
```

#####ORA GOs
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
row_clustered = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_clean %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()


oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_heatmap = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_clean %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  # filter(p_adjust <= 0.50) %>%
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  arrange(p_adjust) %>% 
  # slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "[<>]=Q\\d+"),  
        condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Negative"), "Negative", "Positive"),
        condition = paste(condition, quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black",
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F) +
  # geom_point(aes(size = count),
  #            pch = 21) +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          # axis.line.x  = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 2, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, Gene ontologies, BP") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right",
                     labels = label_wrap(50)) +
  facet_grid(~paste("Day", timepoint), scales = "free_x", space = "free")
```

Lineplot
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

#Total
degs_fit = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_fit_adj < 0.05)
degs_human = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_human_adj < 0.05)
degs_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_mouse_adj < 0.05)

degs_fit_summarize = degs_fit %>% 
    group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(n_genes = n(),
            condition = "FIT") %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_human %>%
              group_by(timepoint) %>%
              summarize(n_genes = n(),
                        condition = "Human"))
degs_fit_summarize

#Overlap
degs_fit_genes = degs_fit %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join
degs_human_and_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "FIT and Human")
#Anti join, Human vs FIT
degs_human_Not_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT FIT")
#Anti join, FIT vs Human
degs_fit_Not_human_genes = degs_fit_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "FIT NOT Human")
  

#Merge data
degs_human_fit_overlap_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human All DEGs") %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_fit_genes %>% 
              mutate(condition = "FIT All DEGs")) %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_fit_genes,
            degs_human_Not_fit_genes,
            degs_fit_Not_human_genes)

degs_human_fit_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_fit_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(condition, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(n = n())

degs_human_fit_overlap_genes_summary
```

### Get overlap

```{r}
degs_human_fit_overlap_common = degs_human_fit_overlap_genes_summary %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("FIT and Human", 
                          "Human All DEGs",
                          "FIT All DEGs")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,
              values_from = "n") %>% 
  mutate(pct_in_human = (`FIT and Human`/`Human All DEGs`)*100,
         pct_in_fit = (`FIT and Human`/`FIT All DEGs`)*100,
         human_common = `FIT and Human`,
         fit_common = `FIT and Human`,
         human_out = (`Human All DEGs` - `FIT and Human`),
         fit_out = (`FIT All DEGs` - `FIT and Human`),
         )  %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(timepoint, "pct_in_human",
                          "pct_in_fit"), 
               names_to = "condition", 
               values_to = "value")  %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("pct_in_fit",
                          "pct_in_human"), names_to = "pct", values_to = "pct_value") %>% 
  filter((str_detect(condition, "human") & str_detect(pct, "human")) |
    (str_detect(condition, "fit") & str_detect(pct, "fit"))) %>% 

  filter(!condition %in% c("Human All DEGs", 
                         "FIT All DEGs",
                         "FIT and Human")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(str_detect(condition, "human"), "Human", "FIT"),
         condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "_common"), "Common", organism),
         condition = fct_rev(condition))

degs_human_fit_overlap_common_plot = degs_human_fit_overlap_common %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = organism,
      y = value,
      fill = interact(condition, organism)) + 
  geom_col(alpha = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint)) +
  geom_text(aes(y = value,
                label = if_else(condition == "Common",paste0(round(pct_value, 1), "%"), "")),
  size = 2.5, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5, angle = 0, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10, expand = c(0.01, 0.01),
                     limits = c(0, 6500)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "FIT" = "#7161ef",
                               "Common" = "black"))   +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Common" = "black",
                               "FIT" = "#7161ef")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.5, 0.95),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2)) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Total", 
       fill = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), limits = c(0, 6500)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.01, 0.01))
```

### By correlation of z score
### Get by zscore
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, z_score_human_fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_human_fit, human_symbol)
zscore_genes_fit

#Get positively and negatively correlated genes and discretize by quantile
#Positively correlated 
positive_correlated = zscore_genes_fit %>%
                    group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_human_fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3))

#Negatively correlated
a_neg = zscore_genes_fit %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_fit < 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_fit)

b_pos = zscore_genes_fit %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_human > 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human)

c_down = a_neg %>% 
  inner_join(b_pos, by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - abs(mean_fit),
         diff = round(diff, 3)) %>% 
  arrange(abs(diff))

a_pos = zscore_genes_fit %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_fit > 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_fit, z_score_human_fit)

b_neg = zscore_genes_fit %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(mean_human < 0) %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_human)

c_up = a_pos %>% 
  inner_join(b_neg, by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(diff = abs(mean_human) - abs(mean_fit),
         diff = round(diff, 3)) %>% 
  arrange(abs(diff))

neg_correlated = bind_rows(c_down, c_up) %>% 
  mutate(mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3))


pos_neg_correlated = neg_correlated %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Negatively correlated") %>% 
  bind_rows(positive_correlated %>% 
              mutate(condition = "Positively correlated"))


quantiles <- quantile(abs(degs_pos_neg_all$diff), 
                    probs = c(0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), 
                    na.rm = TRUE)
degs_pos_neg = pos_neg_correlated%>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_fit$human_symbol),
         human_symbol %in% c(degs_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  #Split by quantile
    mutate(
    Q10 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[1],
    Q25 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[2],
    Q50 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[3],
    Q75 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[4],
    Q100 = abs(diff) <= quantiles[5]
  ) %>%
  #Cumulative
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Q"),
               names_to = "quantile_label",
               values_to = "in_quantile") %>%
  mutate(quantile_label = fct_relevel(quantile_label, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)


degs_pos_neg_split = pos_neg_correlated%>% 
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(degs_fit$human_symbol),
         human_symbol %in% c(degs_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint)  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_diff = cut(abs(diff),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(diff),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")))


degs_pos_neg_all_positive = pos_neg_correlated %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(condition == "Positively correlated") %>% 
  anti_join(pos_neg_correlated %>% 
              filter(condition == "Negatively correlated"),
            by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint"))


degs_pos_neg_all = degs_pos_neg_all_positive %>% 
  bind_rows(pos_neg_correlated %>% 
              filter(condition == "Negatively correlated"))
degs_pos_neg_all
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Calculate
genes_vary_human_all_diff = degs_pos_neg_split %>% 
  filter(quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = if_else(condition == "Positively correlated", "Positive", "Negative"),
    condition_quantile = paste0(condition, " (D", timepoint, ") ", quartiles_grouped)) %>%
  select(-condition) %>% 
  rename(value = diff,
         genes = human_symbol,
         condition = condition_quantile) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)"),
         timepoint = str_extract(timepoint, "\\d+"),
         timepoint = paste("Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Negative"), "Negative", "Positive"),)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"

library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)

#Scatter plot extracted DEGs
genes_vary_human_all_diff_fit = degs_pos_neg_split %>% 
  filter(quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25", "Q75", "Q100")) %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
    quartiles_diff %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = if_else(condition == "Positively correlated", "Positive", "Negative"),
    condition_quantile = paste0(condition, " (D", timepoint, ") ", quartiles_grouped)) %>%
  select(-condition) %>% 
  rename(value = diff,
         genes = human_symbol,
         condition = condition_quantile)

#HHALLMARK
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_df <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = human_gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))


#ORA DIFF
oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit <- oraGO_condition(genes_vary_human_all_diff_fit,
                                                     orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db) %>%
  mutate(log_q = -log10(qvalue)) %>%
  arrange(-log_q)

oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit_clean = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit %>%
  mutate(description = str_replace(description, "regulation", "Reg."),
         description = str_replace(description, "positive", "(+)"),
         description = str_replace(description, "negative", "(-)")) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(timepoint, "\\d+"))

#ORA Hallmarks DIFF

  df = genes_vary_human_all_diff,

  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "\\(D\\d+\\)")) %>%
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
row_clustered = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit_clean %>%

oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit_heatmap = oraGO_all_diff_all_conditions_fit_clean %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(p_adjust <= 0.25) %>%
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  arrange(p_adjust) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "[<>]=Q\\d+"),  
        condition = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Negative"), "Negative", "Positive"),
        condition = paste(condition, quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +

  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#CE1800FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          # axis.line.x  = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 2, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, Gene ontologies, BP") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right",
                     labels = label_wrap(50)) +
  facet_grid(~paste("Day", timepoint), scales = "free_x", space = "free")
```

## Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse

```{r}
pairwise_human_fit_test = read_rds(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_test.rds"))
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Human, Mouse, `FIT Prediction`),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit,
         se_diff_h2fit = se_diff_human_fit,
         se_diff_h2m = se_diff_human_mouse,
         z_score_h2fit = z_score_human_fit,
         z_score_h2m = z_score_human_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism)) 

pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", values_fn = mean) %>% 
  rename(diff_h2fit = diff_h2,
         effect_size_h2fit = effect_size_h2,
         se_diff_h2fit = se_diff_h2,
         z_score_h2fit = z_score_h2,
         p_value_adj_diff_human = p_value_adj,
         p_value_diff_human = p_value) 
 

top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         human_symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  relocate(diff_h2m, p_value_adj_diff_human,ci_width,  .after = organism)  %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_adj_diff_human), diff_h2m)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         human_symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  relocate(diff_h2fit, p_value_adj_diff_human, ci_width,  .after = organism)  %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_adj_diff_human), diff_h2fit) %>% 
   filter(ci_width > 0.0000000)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
pairwise_human_fit_genes_size_plot = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  # filter(!is.na(p_value_diff_human)) %>% 
  mutate(
    # p_value_diff_human = if_else(organism == "Human", pval_adj, p_value_diff_human),
    `<0.01` = abs(p_value_diff_human) <= 0.01,
    `<0.05` = abs(p_value_diff_human) <= 0.05,
    `<0.10` = abs(p_value_diff_human) <= 0.10,
    `<0.25` = abs(p_value_diff_human) <= 0.25,
    # `<1.00` = abs(p_value_diff_human) <= 1.00
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("<"),
               names_to = "threshold_label",
               values_to = "in_threshold") %>%
  mutate(threshold_label = forcats::fct_relevel(
    threshold_label, "<0.01", "<0.05", "<0.10", "<0.25", "<1.00"
  )) %>%
  filter(in_threshold) %>%
  select(-in_threshold) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, threshold_label) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% 
           fct_relevel(., "1", "3", "7")) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = n, 
      fill = organism) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(1), show.legend = F,
           alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = organism,
                color = organism),
            position = position_dodge2(1), size =1) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge2(1),
             pch = 21,
             color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  facet_grid(~threshold_label, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=3}
library(ggridges)
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide_distribution_data = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  # filter(!is.na(p_value_diff_human)) %>% 
  mutate(
    # p_value_diff_human = if_else(organism == "Human", pval_adj, p_value_diff_human),
    `<0.01` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.01,
    `<0.05` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.05,
    `<0.10` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.10,
    `<0.25` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.25,
    `<1.00` = abs(pval_adj) <= 1.00
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("<"),
               names_to = "threshold_label",
               values_to = "in_threshold") %>%
  mutate(threshold_label = forcats::fct_relevel(
    threshold_label, "<0.01", "<0.05", "<0.10", "<0.25", "<1.00"
  )) %>%
  filter(in_threshold) %>%
  select(-in_threshold) 
  
options(scipen = 999)
```

#### Get best and worst genes predicted

Get best and worst genes predicted by mouse and FIT, and see what can be better
Difference in ranks
diff in abs(zvalue mouse2human)  - abs(zvalue fit2human). Why are some genes uniquely reg in each model? Do GSEA

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# FIT
z_scores_best_worst_models = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human",
         human_symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$human_symbol)) %>% 
  relocate(z_score_h2fit, z_score_h2m, diff_h2fit, p_value_adj_diff_human, ci_width,  .after = organism)  %>% 
  fill(z_score_h2fit, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(z_score_h2m, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(diff_z_fit_mouse = abs(z_score_h2fit) - abs(z_score_h2m),
         diff_z_mouse_fit = abs(z_score_h2m) - abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  relocate(diff_z_fit_mouse, diff_z_mouse_fit, .after = organism) 


best_fit = z_scores_best_worst_models %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit))

worst_fit = z_scores_best_worst_models %>%

best_mouse = z_scores_best_worst_models %>% 
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2m))

worst_mouse = z_scores_best_worst_models %>% 
  arrange(-abs(z_score_h2m))

worst_fit_mouse = z_scores_best_worst_models %>%

worst_mouse_fit = z_scores_best_worst_models %>%
```

#### Get ranks
```{r}

ranks_mouse = z_scores_best_worst_models %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, model = organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
```


```{r}
ranks_fit = z_scores_best_worst_models %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, model = organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(human_symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(human_symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "human_symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(human_symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "human_symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=3}
    hclust()
```
