# Regression model performance


## Compute overall metrics 
Import
```{r}
pairwise_human_fit_test = readRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_test.rds"))
pairwise_human_fit_test$human_symbol %>% unique() %>% length() #6373
```


### All genes

#### Calculate metrics
```{r}

library(yardstick)
#FIT
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_fit_adj < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(`FIT Prediction`) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          MAE = mae_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          R2 = rsq_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          Spearman = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs


filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(RMSE)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(MAE)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-R2)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-Spearman)
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs %>% 
  arrange(-Pearson)

```


```{r}
#Mouse
filter_conditions_mouse <- expand_grid(
  padj_mouse = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs <- filter_conditions_mouse %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_mouse, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        p_value_mouse_adj < fc$padj_mouse,
        abs(`Mouse`) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(Human, Mouse),
          MAE = mae_vec(Human, Mouse),
          R2 = rsq_vec(Human, Mouse),
          Spearman = cor(Human, Mouse, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "Mouse") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_RMSE_plot = metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs %>%
```

#### Plot correlation

Mouse vs Human (cutoffs for mouse)

```{r}

  
corr_plots_data = pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse, mean_human, mean_fit,
         pval_human_adj, pval_mouse_adj, pval_fit_adj) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_human_adj, pval_mouse_adj, pval_fit_adj),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    pval_cuts = case_when(
      value <= 0.01 ~ "0.01",
      value <= 0.05 ~ "0.05",
      TRUE ~ "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = pval_cuts,
    values_fn = list  # <- impede erro, mas retorna listas
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(pval_human_adj, pval_mouse_adj, pval_fit_adj)) %>% 
  fill(pval_human_adj, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(pval_mouse_adj, .direction = "up") %>% 
  fill(pval_fit_adj, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(pval_cuts_mouse_human = if_else(pval_human_adj == pval_mouse_adj, pval_human_adj, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_fit_human = if_else(pval_human_adj == pval_fit_adj, pval_fit_adj, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_mouse_fit = if_else(pval_fit_adj == pval_mouse_adj, pval_fit_adj, "Not equal")) 


  
  corr_plots_data
```

### Immune genes

Import
```{r}
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx"))

ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes = ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual %>% 
  separate_rows(genes)

library(yardstick)
```
#### Calculate metrics
```{r}
immune_genes <- unique(ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes$genes) %>% str_to_upper()

#FIT
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs_immune <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(human_symbol %in% c(immune_genes)) %>% 
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_fit_adj < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(`FIT Prediction`) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          MAE = mae_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          R2 = rsq_vec(Human, `FIT Prediction`),
          Spearman = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(Human, `FIT Prediction`, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT_Immune") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs_immune
```

```{r}
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs_Immune = filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs_immune %>% 
  bind_rows(filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs_nonimmune,
            filter_conditions_results_fit_degs_nonimmune,
            filter_conditions_results_fit_degs_immune) %>% 
  mutate(filter = if_else(str_detect(organism, "FIT"), paste0(organism, " CI ", ci_percentile), NA),
         filter = if_else(str_detect(organism, "Mouse"), paste0(organism, " CI ", ci_percentile), filter)) %>% 
  select(organism,filter, everything()) %>% 
  filter(expr_cutoff <= 0.5)

  arrange(-R2) %>%
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Lista de genes imunes
immune_genes <- unique(ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes$genes) %>% str_to_upper()

# Parâmetros
padj_values <- c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, 0.1))
ci_percentiles <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
logfc_cutoffs <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1)
timepoints <- c(1, 3, 7)

# Expandir e aplicar filtros com tipo seguro
plot_data_lfc <- expand.grid(
  padj_fit = padj_values,
  ci_percentile = ci_percentiles,
  expr_cutoff = logfc_cutoffs,
  timepoint = timepoints
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(padj_fit, ci_percentile, expr_cutoff, timepoint) {
    
    df <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == !!timepoint)
    
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(df$ci_width_mouse, probs = ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    df_filtered <- df %>%
      filter(
        pval_mouse_adj < padj_fit,
        abs(Mouse) > expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        padj_fit = paste0("padj < ", padj_fit),
        ci_percentile = paste0("CI ", ci_percentile * 100, "%"),
        expr_cutoff = paste0("log2FC > ", expr_cutoff),
        immune_status = ifelse(str_to_upper(human_symbol) %in% immune_genes, "Immune", "Non-Immune"),
        timepoint = timepoint
      )
    
    if (nrow(df_filtered) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        padj_fit = character(),
        ci_percentile = character(),
        expr_cutoff = character(),
        immune_status = character(),
        timepoint = numeric()
      ))
    } else {
      return(df_filtered)
    }
  })
```

# Classification model performance

```{r}
#Define cutoffs
padj_cutoffs <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50)
l2fc_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.1, 0.5, 1)

# Grid 
cutoff_grid <- expand_grid(padj_cutoff = padj_cutoffs, l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoffs)

# Get DEGs
base_df <- pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  select(human_symbol:ci_high, ci_width) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    z_deg = mean / se,
    p_deg = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_deg)),
    padj_deg = p.adjust(p_deg, method = "BH")
  )

# Apply function
classified_df <- pmap_dfr(
  cutoff_grid,
  function(padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) {
    base_df %>%
      mutate(
        padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
        l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff,
        classification = case_when(
          padj_deg < padj_cutoff & mean > l2fc_cutoff  ~ "up",
          padj_deg < padj_cutoff & mean < -l2fc_cutoff ~ "down",
          TRUE                                          ~ "neutral"
        )
      )
  })


classified_df %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))
```

```{r}
         padj_deg < 0.10) %>%
```

```{r}
# Define o conjunto de métricas corretamente
my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, spec, sens)

### FIT
# "up" vs all
acc_up_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "up")

acc_up_vs_all_fit30 <- classified_eval %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(`FIT (CI 30%)` == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%", target = "up")

# "down" vs all
acc_down_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "down")

acc_down_vs_all_fit30 <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(`FIT (CI 30%)` == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%", target = "down")

acc_fit_results <- bind_rows(acc_up_vs_all_fit, acc_up_vs_all_fit30, acc_down_vs_all_fit, acc_down_vs_all_fit30)

fit_classification_degs_ngenes <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(FIT, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT")

fit_classification_degs_ngenes_ci30 <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(`FIT (CI 30%)`, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT 30%")

fit_classification_degs_ngenes = bind_rows(fit_classification_degs_ngenes, fit_classification_degs_ngenes_ci30)

fit_classification_degs = acc_fit_results %>% 
  rename(truth = target) %>% 
  inner_join(fit_classification_degs_ngenes,
             by = join_by("model", "timepoint", "padj_cutoff", "l2fc_cutoff", "truth"))

fit_classification_degs %>% 
  arrange(-.estimate) %>% 
  filter(num_correct_tp > 0)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=15, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
classification_degs_comparison = read_csv(file = here("FIT_Mouse2man", "classification_degs_comparison.csv"))

classification_degs_accuracy_plot = classification_degs_comparison %>% 
  mutate(l2fc_cutoff = as.character(l2fc_cutoff),
         timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
         padj_cutoff = paste0("padj: ", padj_cutoff)) %>% 
  filter(.metric %in% c("accuracy")) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = l2fc_cutoff,
      y = .estimate,
      color = model) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = truth,
                  # fill = model,
                   size = num_correct_tp),
             alpha = 1,
             fill = NA
             ) +
    scale_size(range = c(0.1, 4),
               # breaks = c(10, 100, 500, 1000)
               ) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=c("up" = 24, 
                                "down" = 25, 
                                "neutral" = 1))+
  scale_shape(solid = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(model, truth))) +
  facet_grid(~timepoint~padj_cutoff, scales = "free_y")+
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 6, expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  )) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy",
    x = "L2FC Cutoff",
    y = "Accuracy",
    color = "Model",
    fill = "Model",
    size = "Correct"
  )
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
AllData_V2.0_distributions_plot = AllData_V2.0 %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(fc_hs:qval_mm),
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(str_detect(metric, "mm"),"Mouse", "Human")) %>% 
  filter(metric %in% c("fc_hs", "fc_mm")) %>% 
  mutate(metric = if_else(str_detect(metric, "fc"), "fc", metric)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value, fill = organism) +
  geom_histogram( position = position_identity(), alpha = 0.5, bins = 50) +
  facet_wrap(~disease, 
             scale = "free_y", axes = "all" 
             # strip.position="right"
             ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    FIT = "#CE1800FF", 
    Mouse = "#546E7AFF",
    Human = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
    scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    FIT = "#CE1800FF", 
    Mouse = "#546E7AFF",
    Human = "#4DBBD5FF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),

  labs(fill = "Organism",
```

## Plot correlation


```{r}
cov_genes_FIT_training = AllData_V2.0 %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(hs_entrez, mean_human = fc_hs, mean_mouse = fc_mm) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>%
               clean_names() %>%
               select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
                      hs_entrez = human_entrez) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)),
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol) %>% 
  summarize(sd_human = sd(mean_human),
            cov = cov(mean_human, mean_mouse),
            mean_human_time = mean(mean_human),
            mean_mouse_time = mean(mean_mouse)) %>% 
  arrange(-cov)

cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(cov) > 0.001) #15891 genes from 6,373 (92.9%)
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(cov) > 0.01) #11320 genes from 6,373 (50.3%)
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(cov) > 0.1) #1151 genes
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(cov) > 0.2) #356 genes
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(cov) > 0.3) #186 genes


genes_vary_human_all_FIT = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  filter(abs(mean_human_time) >= 0.1,
        abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1) %>% 
  arrange(-abs(cov))

genes_vary_mouse_all_FIT = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) >= 0.1,
                abs(mean_human_time) <= 0.1) %>% 
  arrange(-abs(cov))

genes_vary_human_mouse_all_FIT = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  filter(abs(mean_human_time) >= 0.1,
         abs(mean_mouse_time) >= 0.1) %>% 
  arrange(-abs(cov))

genes_not_vary_human_mouse_all_FIT = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
   filter(abs(mean_human_time) <= 0.1, 
          abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1) %>%  
  arrange(-abs(cov))

cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_human_time) > 0.1) #3,962
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_human_time) > 0.2) #2191

cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) > 0.1) #3363
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) > 0.2) #1631

cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) < 0.1) #3,010
cov_genes_FIT_training %>% filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) < 0.2) #4742



genes_vary_human_all_FIT #5,787
genes_vary_mouse_all_FIT #1,807
genes_not_vary_human_mouse_all_FIT #6,476
genes_vary_human_mouse_all_FIT #2,355
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
genes_vary_human = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  ggplot() +

      y = mean_mouse_time) +
    geom_point(color = "#3182bd", fill = NA, pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
    gghighlight(abs(mean_human_time) >= 0.1,
                abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1,
              use_direct_label = FALSE, 
              unhighlighted_params = list(alpha = 0.2, fill = NA)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = human_symbol), max.overlaps = 20, force_pull = 4, size = 3,
                  data = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
                    filter(abs(mean_human_time) > 0.1,
                abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1) %>% 
                  arrange(-abs(cov)) %>% 
                  slice_head(n = 10)) +
   theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Which genes vary only in human?",
       subtitle = "Top 10 genes with highest covariance. Mean cutoff > 0.1.")

                  data = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
                    filter(abs(mean_mouse_time) >= 0.1,

  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Which genes vary only in mouse?",
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"

  bind_rows(genes_vary_mouse_all_FIT %>% 
            select(genes = human_symbol, value = cov) %>% 
              mutate(condition = "Vary in Mouse, mean > 0.1"),
            genes_vary_human_mouse_all_FIT %>%

              mutate(condition = "No variation in Mouse and Human, mean < 0.1"),
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
row_clustered = oraGO_all_cov_all_conditions %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_q) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_q") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()


oraGO_all_cov_all_conditions %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  # filter(p_adjust < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>% 
  arrange(p_adjust) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_q, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ "")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition, "Vary in mouse, mean > 0.1", 
                                 "Vary in human, mean > 0.1", 
                                 "Vary in Mouse and Human, mean > 0.1"
                                 )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=fct_rev(condition), y = description, fill = log_q)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = count),
             pch = 21) +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          axis.line  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          # panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 2, 2, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "vertical",
          legend.position = "left") +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "Top 5 enriched genes, ORA") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(15)) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          axis.line  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 4, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "Top 5 enriched genes, GSEA, by covariance") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#4DBBD5FF",      # azul para -1
        mid = "white",          # branco para 0
        high = "#DC0000FF",     # vermelho para +1
        midpoint = 0, 
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(-1, 1),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "NES") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
```

```{r}
target_gene <- "26119"

X <- df_mouse %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mm_entrez, values_from = fc_mm) %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

y_target <- df_human %>%
  filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
  select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id")  %>% 
  select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

train_df = full_df

# Correlation
top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 100) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)

train_df <- full_df %>%
  select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

# Split into train and test
set.seed(123)
data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)
train_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, repeats = 5)

# Recipe
rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())
```



```{r}
rf_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec) %>%
  add_model(rf_model)

mer_metrics <- metric_set(yardstick::rmse,
                          yardstick::rsq)


#Cross validation
set.seed(234)
trees_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

doParallel::registerDoParallel()

rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
  wf,
  metrics = mer_metrics,
  resamples = trees_folds,
  grid = 20
)


# Check
rf_tuned %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  ggplot()+
  aes(x = mtry, y = mean, colour = .metric, label = mtry) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_label() +
  scale_color_npg()+
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(.metric), scales = "free")

best_model <- select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")

# 6. Finalizar e avaliar
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)

preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)

metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)


# Extraia o modelo ajustado diretamente
final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit

library(vip)
# Gere o gráfico de importância
vip(final_model, num_features = 20)

vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene)

head(vip_df, 10)
```

### Multiple genes


#### Random forest
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

model_rf_by_gene <- function(target_gene, df_mouse, df_human, top_n = 50) {
  
  rf_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("regression")
  
  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(rf_model)
  
  # CV
  set.seed(234)
  trees_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)
  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)
  
  rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    resamples = trees_folds,
    grid = 5
  )
  
  best_model <- select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")
  
  # Extraia os valores de RMSE e RSQ do melhor modelo
  best_metrics <- rf_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(mtry == best_model$mtry)
  
  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)
  rsq_val  <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rsq")  %>% pull(mean)
  
  final_wf   <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit  <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  # VIP com métricas adicionadas
  vi(final_model) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
    mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene,
           rmse = rmse_val,
           rsq = rsq_val)
  
  
  vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene)
  
  results = vip_df %>% inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez)  %>% 
    arrange(-Importance)
  results
  preds
  metrics_pred
}
```

#### Lasso

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)


model_lasso_by_gene <- function(target_gene, X, df_human, top_n = 50, cor_values) {

  y_target <- df_human %>%
    filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(csp_id)

  full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id") %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  if (nrow(full_df) < 10) return(NULL)  # ignora se poucos dados

  top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 50) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)


  train_df <- full_df %>%
    select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  # Split
  set.seed(123)
  data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
  train_data <- training(data_split)
  test_data  <- testing(data_split)

  rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
    update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  # Modelo LASSO
  lasso_model <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>%
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(lasso_model)

  set.seed(234)
  lasso_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

  lambda_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-4, 0)), levels = 20)

  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)

  lasso_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = lasso_folds,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    grid = lambda_grid
  )

  best_model <- select_best(lasso_tuned, metric = "rmse")

  best_metrics <- lasso_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(penalty == best_model$penalty)

  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)

  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  results = vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene) %>% 
inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez) 

return(list(
    results = results,
    metrics_pred = metrics_pred,
    preds = preds
  ))
}

```

```{r}
# Simular dados ----------------------------

n <- 100  # número de amostras

colnames(X) <- paste0("GeneM", 1:p)
```

```{r}
# Ajuste Lasso multivariado ----------------------------

# Ajuste com validação cruzada para escolher lambda ideal
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, Y, family = "mgaussian", alpha = 1)

# Lambda ideal
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min
cat("Melhor lambda:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Previsões
preds <- predict(cv_fit, newx = X, s = "lambda.min")

# Converter para tibble
preds_df <- as_tibble(preds[,,1])  # 3D array -> 2D matrix
colnames(preds_df) <- paste0("Pred_", colnames(Y))

# Coeficientes
coefs <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")  # Lista com 1 por resposta

# Combinar todos os coeficientes em uma tabela
coef_df <- map2_dfr(coefs, names(coefs), ~ {
  as.matrix(.x) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
    rename(Coefficient = 1) %>%
    mutate(Target = .y)
})


# Salvar objetos ----------------------------

write_csv(as_tibble(Y), "Y_true.csv")
write_csv(preds_df, "Y_pred.csv")
write_csv(coef_df, "lasso_coefficients.csv")

saveRDS(cv_fit, "lasso_multivariate_model.rds")

```

```{r}
df_human_final <- df_human[, top_genes]


# Filter by correlation
cor_genes <- map_dbl(colnames(df_mouse), function(gene) {
  cor(df_mouse[[gene]], df_human[[gene]], use = "complete.obs")
})
names(cor_genes) <- colnames(df_mouse)
genes_filtered_corr <- names(cor_genes)[abs(cor_genes) > 0.75]

# Filtrar os dataframes mantendo somente os genes selecionados
df_mouse_filtered <- df_mouse[, genes_filtered_corr]
df_human_filtered <- df_human[, genes_filtered_corr]

# Conferir dimensões
dim(df_mouse_filtered)
dim(df_human_filtered)
length(genes_filtered_corr)
dim(df_mouse)
dim(df_mouse_filtered)
dim(df_mouse_final)
dim(df_human)
dim(df_human_filtered)
dim(df_human_final)

#As matrix

df_mouse.matrix = as.matrix(df_mouse_filtered)

fit <- glmnet(
  x = df_mouse.matrix,

)
```
